description: Looks up coupon codes for one online store. Offers come from official affiliate-network feeds; each offer shows when it was last seen in its feed (null when the feed does not report it); offers past their listed end date are never returned. Badges mark TakeDeals-verified coupons and official brand-program coupons. Results are ranked verified first, then by stated saving, never by commission. Links may be affiliate links at no cost to the shopper. Use when the user asks for a promo, coupon or discount code for a named store. When no code is listed, the store's current no-code deals are returned in no_code_deals.

country.description: Shopper's two-letter ISO country code such as US, GB or AE. Keeps offers valid for that country, including worldwide ones.

store.description: Store name, domain or any URL on the store, for example 'aliexpress.com'. Any spelling that names the store is matched to it.

name: find_coupons
title: Find Coupon Codes
